title: OpenGHM snapshot metadata
description: metadata.json for one WBM snapshot. Fields are grouped by where their contents come from: about (a person, at publish), simulation (derived from the selected .init), uses (the publisher, at publish), runtime (the system). See docs/reference/metadata-format.md.

$schema.description: This document's own schema version URL, e.g. https://schemas.openghm.org/snapshot-spec/metadata/1.0.0.json.

id.description: Minted at publish, 256 random bits as lowercase hex. Not derived from the snapshot's content (ADR 0014). The S3 key under snapshots/.

slug.description: The human name at publish time. Not part of the S3 key; the catalog maps slug to id for browsing, and may remap it later without touching this file.

init.description: Path relative to wbm_init/, not a bare filename assumption — a snapshot can hold several .init files. Resolves to <snapshot>/wbm_init/<init>.

inputVariables.description: What the run is driven by: one entry per forcing time series the .init actually names — see metadata-format.md#forcing-roles. Variable length, not a fixed pair, but `role` is a closed vocabulary and a new role is an additive MINOR bump. `role` is unique within the array; JSON Schema cannot express that, so the generator and the validator enforce it.

dataset.description: The MT record driving this role, named by its own Code_Name field — read from inside the .init the run's MT_* key points at, not assumed from that file's basename. The two agree for the climate forcing used today (merra2_prectotcorr_d.init declares Code_Name merra2_prectotcorr_d) but not in general: several records in the staged ancillary data declare a Code_Name that differs from their filename (see model-input-spec's datasets[].code).

fullName.description: The MT record's Name, e.g. 'MERRA2 Temperature at 2m, Daily'. Optional because it is copied out of a file that leaves the bundle under ADR 0015 — recording it here is what keeps this document readable without that file.

unit.description: The MT record's Units — what WBM reads the series as, after Var_Scale and Var_Offset. NOT Orig_Units, which is the unit of the file on disk before scaling (e.g. K, not C; kg/(m^2 s), not mm/day). Optional for the same reason as fullName.

outputVariables.description: What the run computes: one entry per name in the .init's Output_vars, resolved through the model's variable dictionary — see metadata-format.md.

unit.description: The dictionary's Org_units[0] — the native unit, not an aggregated one.

id.description: Minted at publish, same rule as the snapshot id (ADR 0014). Two snapshots built from the same input data share this value.

cluster.description: Every compute-node fact in this project assumes one cluster today. A second cluster is an additive MINOR bump.

slurmTime.description: SLURM --time syntax, not an ISO 8601 duration: minutes, minutes:seconds, hours:minutes:seconds, days-hours[:minutes[:seconds]]. Hours are not capped at 24 (observed: 111:30:00).

unknown.description: Recorded when a past run's own record (SLURM accounting, logs) could not be recovered at rewrite time. Allowed only in runtime.execution's observation fields (cores, elapsedWalltime, startedAt, finishedAt, slurmJobId), never in cluster or anywhere else.
